question:
Batch 40 = LAW L-y VOICEOVER IS MINIMAL (orchestrator 2026-11-12 '20:30'; PBX: too much voiceover, keep only one line at the end). For a package of type 'moments' the video is hook -> clip -> clip (-> clip) back to back, then ONE takeaway line after the LAST clip, then the sign-off. No VO intro after the hook. A bridge between two clips is the exception: at most ONE per video, and the package records why it was needed. New EDL rule edl_rules.rule_r11 (registered in validate_edl, which rejects the EDL before cutting if any rule fails): for package_type 'moments' only: a non-empty intro (or a non-string intro) fails; every VO line whose after_clip is not exactly the last clip index counts as a bridge between clips; more than one such bridge fails; each such bridge needs a non-empty string 'why'; a malformed vo / clips / bridges fails closed. Story-type and untyped EDLs (protected references) pass unchanged. R4-moments is unchanged (it never had a minimum VO share; its 45 % cap stays an upper bound). pinned.moments_vo now copies a bridge's 'why' from the package into the EDL when present. Tests: test_edl_rules TestR11VoShape, test_pinned test_a_bridges_recorded_reason_reaches_the_edl.
FIND: any way an intro or a second bridge between clips passes for a moments package; a bridge between clips passing without a usable reason; the takeaway (the line after the last clip) wrongly counted as a bridge; a story-type or untyped EDL wrongly affected; tests that do not test what they claim. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

consensus_findings.issue: Malformed clips pass: the rule only checks clips is a non-empty list, not that each clip has a valid integer index. If no clip has an int index, last is None and with no bridges the rule returns True, violating fail-closed for malformed clips.
consensus_findings.evidence: if not isinstance(vo, dict) or not isinstance(clips, list) or not clips: ... last = max((c.get("index") for c in clips if isinstance(c, dict) and type(c.get("index")) is int), default=None)
consensus_findings.fix: Validate each clip is a dict with an int index, or fail if last is None.

rejected_findings.issue: Malformed bridges pass: bridges=None is treated as an empty list, and a bridge with an out-of-range after_clip (e.g., 99 when last=3) is counted as a valid bridge if it has a 'why', so malformed bridges do not fail closed.
rejected_findings.evidence: bridges = vo.get("bridges") if vo.get("bridges") is not None else [] ... between = [b for b in bridges if not (isinstance(b, dict) and type(b.get("after_clip")) is int and b["after_clip"] == last)]
rejected_findings.fix: Require bridges to be a list (reject None) and validate each bridge's after_clip is an int within the set of clip indices (or 1..last), failing closed otherwise.

rejected_findings.issue: A whitespace-only intro passes because intro.strip() is falsy, but the spec says a non-empty intro fails; '   ' is a non-empty string.
rejected_findings.evidence: if intro is not None and (not isinstance(intro, str) or intro.strip()):
rejected_findings.fix: Fail for any non-empty string intro, e.g., `if intro is not None and (not isinstance(intro, str) or intro):`.
